content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: New Record Screen ## slug: vt-new-record-screen ## seoTitle: New Record Screen ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End The New Record screen allows you to create new records from the {{variable.Field_VT_RelatedTo}} field on the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}}. ## Account and Contact The Account and Contact "New Record" screens have predefined fields available, and a Field Set record is automatically created. 1. Navigate to the Account or Contact Object in Setup. 2. Click **Field Sets**. 3. Click **Edit** next to "Virtual Terminal." 4. Remove, add, and modify the fields within that box to fit your use case. Fields "In the Field Set" box are the fields currently on the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}}'s new Account or Contact record screen. 5. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![New Record Screen_1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/New%20Record%20Screen_1.png){height="" width=""} ## Other Objects Related To objects besides Account and Contact, show a blank New Record screen. To create new records, you will need to manually create a Field Set. For example, the new Lead screen looks like this before adding a Field Set. ![New Record Screen_2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/New%20Record%20Screen_2.png){height="" width=""} 1. Navigate to the Lead Object in Setup. 2. Click **Field Sets**. 3. Click **New**. 4. Add values to the following fields: * {{variable.Field_NewRecScrn_FieldSetLabel}} = "Virtual Terminal" * {{variable.Field_NewRecScrn_FieldSetName}} = "Virtual Terminal" If the {{variable.Field_NewRecScrn_FieldSetName}} value is different than above, the fields will not display on the {{variable.Component_VirtualTerminal}} screen. 5. Drag the fields you want to use for creating a new {{variable.Object_Lead}} record to the "In the Field Set" box. 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![New Record Screen_3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/New%20Record%20Screen_3.png){height="" width=""} The screen now has fields and will create new Lead records!
